captions.detailed: A square kitchen window box fan featuring a light gray housing with circular grilles on both faces. Inside the housing, a black six-blade propeller is mounted on a central axle, designed to rotate continuously. On the front right face, a small black fluted speed knob is positioned on a side shaft. Two dark gray T-shaped stabilizer feet are attached to the bottom edge of the housing via small hinges, allowing them to swing downward for stable placement.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a kitchen window box fan with a square housing, circular grilles, a central six-blade propeller, a side speed knob, and two fold-out stabilizer feet. The propeller and speed knob should have continuous rotational degrees of freedom, while the stabilizer feet should pivot on revolute joints.
captions.factory: Create a square hollow box for the main housing using boolean subtractions, then add circular spoke grilles on the front and back. Model the propeller by patterning six angled blades around a central cylinder hub. Construct the speed knob as a fluted cylinder on a side-mounted shaft. Form the stabilizer feet as T-shaped blocks, and assemble all components using revolute joints for the feet and continuous rotational joints for the propeller and knob.
